title: UseCaseVector
description: A complex, multidimensional schema representing a Use Case Vector for High-Frequency Trading (HFT) and Arbitrage simulations. This vector encapsulates strategy parameters, market conditions, latency constraints, and risk profiles used to generate algorithmic trading signals.

vector_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific simulation vector instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this vector was computed or captured.

simulation_type.description: The classification of the trading strategy being simulated.

vector_components.description: The raw numerical representation of the use case vector, normalized for machine learning model input.

market_context.description: Detailed snapshot of the market environment at the time of vector generation.

liquidity_depth_score.description: A calculated score representing the depth of the order book (0.0 to 100.0).

bid_ask_spread_basis_points.description: The spread between the best bid and ask prices in basis points.

dominant_exchange.description: The primary exchange venue influencing this vector.

correlated_assets.description: List of asset tickers that show high correlation in this timeframe.

hft_parameters.description: Specific parameters related to High-Frequency Trading execution logic.

max_latency_tolerance_ns.description: Maximum acceptable network latency in nanoseconds before the signal is invalidated.

co_location_tier.description: The infrastructure proximity to the exchange matching engine.

tick_to_trade_ratio.description: Ratio of market data ticks processed to trades executed.

order_book_imbalance_threshold.description: Threshold for order book imbalance (0.0 to 1.0) to trigger a signal.

risk_profile.description: Risk management constraints embedded within the vector.

sharpe_ratio_target.description: Target Sharpe ratio for the strategy simulation.

integrity_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the vector components to ensure data integrity during transmission.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for extending the vector definition with custom simulation tags.
